name: CPIRE
purpose: Estimate California youth water polo team strength using connected game evidence.
ranking_question: If these teams played tomorrow on a neutral site, who is more likely to win?
principles: CPIRE estimates team strength, not tournament trophies.
Close losses to elite teams can be useful evidence.
Tournament path matters more than final placement alone.
Confidence measures certainty of the estimate, not team quality.
Resume information explains the ranking but does not replace the rating model.

public_language.short_description: CPIRE ranks teams by estimating demonstrated strength across the connected California water polo results graph.
public_language.confidence: Confidence reflects how much data supports the rating.
